description: GPU inference and serving engine for automatic speech recognition: Whisper, WeNet Conformer, icefall Zipformer and RNN-T, Nemotron ASR, FunASR Paraformer and Qwen2-Audio, offline and streaming, behind an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API, a realtime WebSocket and gRPC.
rules: Install OASR from source: git clone https://github.com/chiendb97/oasr.git, git submodule update --init, then pip install -e ".[all]". The package is named oasr-server and imports as oasr; the oasr package on PyPI is an unrelated project and replaces the oasr command.
OASR serves on NVIDIA GPUs of compute capability 7.5 or newer with CUDA 11.8 or newer; it is not built to serve on CPU.
An ASREngine runs in one mode for its lifetime, set by EngineConfig(service_mode="offline") or the default service_mode="streaming"; requests of the other mode are rejected.

EngineConfig.ckpt_dir and oasr-server --ckpt-dir accept a local WeNet, icefall, FunASR, Hugging Face or native OASR checkpoint directory, or a Hugging Face Hub repo id; the format is detected automatically.
Load an icefall pruned-transducer checkpoint with architecture="transducer"; without it the directory is detected as Zipformer CTC.
To use OASR as an OpenAI-compatible transcription server, run oasr-server and set the OpenAI client's base_url to http://<host>:8080/v1; the model field is ignored unless --served-model-name is set.
oasr-server has no authentication and does not terminate TLS; keep it on a private network or behind a reverse proxy.
Build new model architectures from oasr.layers and register them with register_model; do not edit the engine core to add a variant.
